original_ai_output.title_zh: 工人团体在#EndSARS抗议六周年之际要求为受害者伸张正义并赔偿
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 工人权利运动（WRC）和社会主义工人联盟（SWL）在2020年#EndSARS抗议六周年之际发表声明，要求为受伤、被拘留者及遇害者家属伸张正义并提供赔偿。这些团体还呼吁对杀戮事件进行独立调查，要求联邦政府公开道歉，并呼吁尼日利亚青年和工人再次动员起来反对警察暴力和不良治理。他们表示，抗议后各州政府设立的司法调查委员会提出的多项建议仍未落实，部分受害者和家属尚未获得赔偿。

key_facts.fact: 工人权利运动（WRC）和社会主义工人联盟（SWL）要求为2020年#EndSARS抗议的受害者伸张正义并赔偿
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Workers’ Rights Campaign (WRC) and the Socialist Workers League (SWL) have called for justice for victims of the 2020 #EndSARS protests, demanding compensation for those injured or detained and the families of people killed during the demonstrations.

key_facts.fact: 这些团体呼吁对杀戮事件进行独立调查，并要求联邦政府公开道歉
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the groups also called for an independent investigation into the killings, a public apology from the Federal Government

key_facts.fact: 这些团体称，抗议后设立的司法调查委员会提出的多项建议仍未落实，部分受害者尚未获得赔偿
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: several recommendations made by judicial panels of inquiry established by state governments after the protests remained unimplemented, while some victims and their families were yet to receive compensation

key_facts.fact: #EndSARS抗议于2020年10月爆发，起因是广泛投诉警察暴力，尤其是现已解散的特别反抢劫小队（SARS）的活动
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The #EndSARS protests erupted in October 2020 following widespread complaints about police brutality, particularly the activities of the now-disbanded Special Anti-Robbery Squad (SARS).

key_facts.fact: 2020年10月20日拉各斯莱基收费站枪击事件成为危机中最突出且最具争议的事件之一
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the October 20, 2020, shootings at the Lekki Toll Gate in Lagos becoming one of the most prominent and controversial episodes of the crisis

uncertainties: 该报道为单一来源（Sahara Reporters），尚缺乏交叉验证
司法调查委员会建议未落实及赔偿未到位的情况系相关团体的说法，未获独立确认
